sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:30

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:30:1
items.html: The Akudim: the matter of the discernment of the Taamim, Nekudot, Tagin and letters in them has already been explained above: As above (Part 4, Chapter 3, item 11), that the first expansion of the Partzuf, which is direct light and mercy, is regarded as the Taamim [tastes] in it. And when it begins to diminish by the force of the refinement of the screen, when the remaining four small levels emerge, from Hochma to Malchut, they are regarded as the discernment of the Nekudot in it. And the records that remain from the Taamim are the Tagin [crowns] in it. And the records that remain from the discernments of the Nekudot, from the discernments of the sparks that fall from them into the vessels, are called letters. Study it there well.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:30:2
items.html:
The Nekudim are the first lights that came out at first. He tells us that here the order changed from what it was in the three previous Partzufim of AK. For there the Gadlut came out first, which are the Taamim, and afterwards the small degrees came out, which are the Nekudot. But here, in the world of Nekudim, the Katnut [smallness/infancy] came out first, and afterwards the Gadlut came out; for at first only the GAR [first three] came out, in the lights of Ruach and Nefesh, that is, the level of ZA, as above. And afterwards AB and SAG coupled, and the Parsa was breached, and the lights of GAR descended to the Nekudim, and also to the seven lower Sefirot, as above.
And this is what he says, “that the Nekudot are the lights that came out at first,” that is, the opposite of the previous Partzufim Galgalta, AB and SAG of AK, where the Taamim came out first, whereas here the discernments of the Nekudot came out first, that is, the Katnut, and afterwards the Gadlut. Yet even so, the illumination of the Gadlut of the Nekudim is not called Taamim, because they were not in the discernment of mercy, for here, in those lights and by their cause, the matter of the breaking of the vessels occurred, as written below.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:30:3
items.html: And the letters are the vessels. And they include also the sparks that fell inside them at the time of the departure of the lights from them, in the manner that occurred in the Akudim, as will be explained in its place.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:30:4
items.html: And the Taamim are the new name MA. For those Taamim that came out in the world of Nekudim — that is, the Gadlut that came out through the coupling of AB and SAG, which are the Taamim of the Nekudim — did not endure in the Nekudim, but only after the Taamim of the new MA corrected them. And therefore they are named after MA, as written in its place.
